title: Interlaken-style lane: 64b/67b framing, scrambling, metaframe (sync, scrambler state, skip, diagnostic with CRC-32), bursts with CRC-24, in-band flow control

regs.name: FC
regs.desc: In-band flow control sent in every control word

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: Transmit word (TX0 = bits 31:0, TX1 = bits 63:32, TX2 = flags and channel; writing TX2 commits it); a burst control word takes SOP and channel of the word waiting, the word itself goes out next; one word per 67 PCLK

fdesc.tx_bytes: with EOP: valid bytes of the word (0 = 8)

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: Received word (RX0 = bits 31:0, RX1 = bits 63:32, RX2 = flags; reading RX2 frees it); each data word arrives once the next protocol word shows whether it ends the packet

fdesc.rx_err: its burst failed the CRC-24 (or the lane lost sync)

fields.desc: from the last control word that passed its CRC-24
{lane, link} status from the peer's last good diagnostic word

irqs.name: ERR_WORD
irqs.desc: invalid framing bits while word locked

irqs.name: ERR_SYNC
irqs.desc: a sync word missing while sync locked

irqs.name: ERR_SCR
irqs.desc: a scrambler state word that does not match

irqs.name: ERR_CRC32
irqs.desc: a diagnostic word whose CRC-32 does not match the metaframe

irqs.name: ERR_CRC24
irqs.desc: a control word whose CRC-24 fails

irqs.name: ERR_PROTO
irqs.desc: a protocol error (data outside a burst, EOP without data, SOP inside a packet, burst without SOP outside one, framing word out of place)

notes: tx_p and rx_p are the serial lane pins (one bit per PCLK); they pass through unchanged.
The core parameters MF (metaframe length, 64), BMAX (data words per burst, 8) and SEED (scrambler start) keep their defaults.
